state.memo:
# Compliance review

## Feature

An internal tool lets our head-office employees book desks and meeting rooms for the week. Bookings are anonymous: the tool stores and shows only the room name and the time slot, never an employee name, ID or any other personal data.

## Questions researched

- **q1** Does the DPDP Rules 2025 impose any obligations on an internal tool that stores only room names and time slots and no personal data of employees or anyone else?

## Findings (0)

No verified findings: the retrieved regulation states no obligation this feature touches.
